challenge.method: Under pinned SCES-1.0 §§3–4 and Protocol stage 7, compared the project preface with the reproduced LGPL clauses 2 and 6. Tested whether ordinary LGPL linking terms explain the passage and whether the permission reaches every modified Core System.
challenge.results: The project preface expressly dispenses with additional clause 6 requirements for the specified executable. It defines a publicly distributed version as INRIA's unmodified distribution or a modified version distributed under clause 2. The claim preserves that boundary.
